name: artifree-workspace
description: An open workspace for agent-made artifacts. Initial scaffolding.

scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @artifree/web
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:web && npm run build:architecture
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspace @artifree/web && tsc -p docs/architecture/tsconfig.json
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace --locked
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run check:contracts && npm run check:boundaries && npm run typecheck && npm run check:rust
